Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_indication via molregno; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures via molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4; drug_indication.efo_term = 'cardiovascular disease'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind ascending.
